pinned_mlx_vlm.fact: Decoder and vision call fast SDPA without an explicit probability cast.

facts: The vector path uses float score, probability and output accumulators and directly multiplies the FP32 exponential by values.
The M5 NAX path keeps its score/probability tile typed float and passes it to an MPP mixed-operand matmul with relaxed precision enabled; no explicit BF16 probability cast appears at the call site.
The GPU dispatch selects vector mode at query lengths at most eight.

interpretation: BF16 probability storage is explicit in the official eager graph when query dtype is BF16.
Backend-dispatched SDPA does not establish one universal intermediate storage boundary across all valid implementations.
The current FP64 oracle is an ideal SDPA reference with named activation boundaries, not a faithful emulation of the eager BF16 graph.
An eager-graph variant must also account for query-dtype QK matmul/scaling outputs; changing only P is not proof of faithful eager arithmetic.
This audit does not authorize a BF16 precision cut in the current native FP32-probability baseline or waive the existing fidelity and performance gates.
